brief:
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced Monday that he will disband the New York Police Department's Strategic Response Group, fulfilling a campaign promise, Middle East Eye reported. The SRG was deployed during pro-Palestinian protests in the city.

Mamdani said the unit will be replaced, though the announcement did not specify what structure would take its place or when the disbanding would occur.

title: NYC mayor pledges to disband NYPD unit used in protest crackdowns
